integrity: The proof converts monotone data to nonnegative increments, orders the resulting coefficient functions exactly, and optimizes a linear functional over the full increment simplex. The remaining one-variable extrema are solved analytically, and the packaged checker replays all polynomial and quadratic-field identities exactly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the ordinary four-node cubic Lagrange polynomial on the central cell of a uniform scalar grid. It does not classify nonuniform stencils, higher degree interpolation, or global piecewise schemes with changing stencils.
title: Sharp monotone range defect of uniform four-point cubic Lagrange interpolation
